response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (observatories with no telescopes are not included in the average share).
The total number of telescopes is the row count of the telescopes table.
